name: Subscribr
description: Build a repeatable YouTube production system with Claude. Subscribr helps you discover high-potential video ideas, research what is working on YouTube, shape stronger titles and thumbnail directions, write better scripts, and keep every project moving from idea to publish-ready. Spend less time switching between tools and more time creating videos your audience wants to watch.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Subscribr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Subscribr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://subscribr.ai/mcp/subscribr. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Subscribr MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Subscribr lists 23 MCP tools, including add_project_comment, commit_voice_profile, create_project, generate_ideas, get_channel_workspace, get_operation, get_project, get_research_video, get_script_project, get_youtube_channel, get_youtube_video, and list_my_work.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Subscribr?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Subscribr in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Subscribr requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Subscribr is developed by Subscribr LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
